question: In which of the following states is the Ashtamudi Lake located?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Kerela__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most visited backwater lake in** Kerala** is Ashtamudi Lake.
 
• It located in the **Kollam District** in the Indian state of Kerala
 
• It has a unique wetland ecology and **a vast palm-shaped water body.**
 
• The lake is also known as the "**Gateway to Kerala's Backwaters**".

 [IMAGE: https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcR8QWDJMfUBwMXEvR8eOEO3hOcLxqYmD2ars7EorVp82g&s] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It is widely renowned for its houseboats and backwater resorts.
 
• The** Ramsar Convention for the protection and sustainable usage of wetlands** designated Ashtamudi Wetland as a wetland of international significance.
